name: F4 UI shell — message window, command window, Yes/No

steps.msg: demo controls exposed

steps.note: 1. the message window opens with a quick unroll (frames captured deterministically under freeze/advance)

steps.msg: message window animates open, not instant
...and settles open within ~150 ms

steps.note: 2. typewriter: glyph by glyph at reading pace, with a tick per glyph

steps.assert: (() => { const t = __DQ.state().ui.text; return t && t.typing && t.shown > 8 && t.shown < t.total; })()
steps.msg: text is mid-type: partly shown

steps.eval: (() => { const a = __DQ.state().ui.text.shown; __DQ.advance(1000); const b = __DQ.state().ui.text.shown; window.__gps = b - a; return {a, b, perSecond: b - a}; })()

steps.msg: about 35 glyphs per second (spaces cheap, punctuation pauses)

steps.assert: (() => { const t = __DQ.state().ui.text; return t.caret === true && t.page === 1 && t.pages === 2 && t.lines <= 3; })()
steps.msg: the ▼ caret bobs when a page is done and more follows

steps.note: 3. confirm turns the page; confirm while typing completes it at once

steps.msg: Enter turns to page 2, which starts typing
a text tick per typed letter, in real time

steps.assert: (() => { const t = __DQ.state().ui.text; return t.pageDone && t.skipped && t.shown === t.total; })()
steps.msg: confirm while typing reveals the whole page (__DQ.press -> F2 Input -> Scenes.input -> UI.input)
per-speaker glyph voice

steps.note: 4. the command window: cascade open, cursor, 2-column navigation with wrap

steps.assert: (() => { const w = __DQ.state().ui.windows; return w.some(x => x.id === 'command') && w.some(x => ['party','gold'].includes(x.id) && x.state === 'opening'); })()
steps.msg: command, party and gold windows cascade open

steps.assert: (() => { const w = __DQ.state().ui.windows; const ids = w.filter(x => x.state === 'open').map(x => x.id); return ['command','party','gold'].every(i => ids.includes(i)); })()
steps.msg: command, party and gold windows open

steps.assert: (() => { const c = __DQ.state().ui.windows.find(w => w.id === 'command'); return c.selected === 'talk' && c.items.join() === 'Talk,Spells,Status,Items,Equip,Search'; })()
steps.msg: cursor starts on Talk

steps.eval: (async () => { const a = __DQ.cursorTransform('command'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 170)); const b = __DQ.cursorTransform('command'); window.__bob = {a, b}; return window.__bob; })()

steps.msg: the focused cursor is alive (bobs)
down moves to Status with a blip
right moves across the row
right wraps within the row
up wraps from the top of the column to the bottom
back to Items

steps.note: 5. nesting: Items opens a titled, scrolling bag over the command window; the parent cursor rests

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.state().ui; const c = s.windows.find(w => w.id === 'command'); const b = s.windows.find(w => w.id === 'items'); return s.focus === 'items' && c.state === 'open' && !c.focused && b.title === 'Bram' && s.sounds.last.includes('confirm'); })()
steps.msg: bag has focus, command stays open underneath, confirm thunk played

steps.eval: (async () => { const a = __DQ.cursorTransform('command'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 170)); const b = __DQ.cursorTransform('command'); window.__rest = {a, b}; return window.__rest; })()

steps.msg: the parent's cursor rests while a child window has focus
keys are coming through F2 (input.js); the raw fallback stood down

steps.assert: (() => { const b = __DQ.state().ui.windows.find(w => w.id === 'items'); return b.index >= 4 && (b.scroll > 0 || b.index === 4); })()
steps.msg: holding down repeats the cursor (F2 menu repeat) and the list scrolls to keep it in view
a third window nests on top
cancel closes the child, focus returns to the bag
cancel again returns to the command window

steps.note: 6. every menu can be left: cancel closes the command window; the inn asks Yes/No

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.state().ui; const y = s.windows.find(w => w.id === 'yesno'); const m = s.windows.find(w => w.kind === 'message'); return !s.windows.some(w => ['command','party','gold'].includes(w.id)) && y.selected === 'yes' && s.text.text.includes('Eight gold') && y.rect.y + y.rect.h <= m.rect.y && m.rect.y - (y.rect.y + y.rect.h) < 30; })()
steps.msg: Yes/No sits just above the message window, cursor on Yes
down selects No
Yes pays 8 gold; the prompt closed

steps.note: 7. arbitrary content (columns, dividers, labels) and canvas text in 3D

steps.msg: a content window takes input
and hands focus back when dismissed
font.js sprites built
pagination never exceeds 3 lines or overflows; parser, wrap and 34-char rule behave

steps.assert: (() => { const s = __DQ.state().ui; const m = s.windows.find(w => w.kind === 'message'); return s.unit > 1.1 && s.text.lines <= 3 && m.rect.x >= 0 && m.rect.x + m.rect.w <= 1280 && m.rect.y + m.rect.h <= 720; })()
steps.msg: UI.setScale re-lays the text: still <= 3 lines, window still on screen
screenshotReady when nothing is mid-animation
fps
no runtime errors
